staff.bio: Fr. Mark was born in Rapid City, SD, and grew up in the Black Hills. He attended St. Martin's College in Lacey, WA, and graduated with a degree in Philosophy. He then attended Mount Angel Seminary in St. Benedict, OR, where he earned a Master of Divinity degree. Fr. Mark was ordained to the priesthood on May 30, 1999, and has served in various parishes throughout the Diocese of Rapid City.
staff.name: Fr. Mark McCormick
staff.duties: Fr. Mark is serving as Head Pastor of St. Thérèse the Little Flower & the St. Carlo Acutis Catholic Student Center, serving alongside Fr. Todd VanderMay.

staff.bio:
Growing up on a farm southwest of Huron, SD, I earned my Chemical Engineering degree from South Dakota Mines before spending three years as a full-time missionary with FOCUS Catholic. Today, I serve as the Director of Evangelization and Adult & Family Formation at St. Thérèse the Little Flower Parish in Rapid City. Driven by a love for classical learning and Catholic youth formation. 

I currently live in the Rapid Valley area with my wife Katie and daughter Lucia.
staff.name: Kevin Baltzer
staff.duties:
I'm in charge of Adult & Family Ministry, which is being taught on Wednesdays — see the "Faith Formation" tab for more information.
I'm also the staff designated IT guy who built this new website and will keep it running and updated!

titles.title: Director of Evangelization & Adult & Family Formation

staff.bio:
I have been blessed to work at the parish for over 22 years!  
I grew up in Rapid City and went to college at USD.  I was in advertising with the RC Journal until my 3rd child was born, then stayed home with kiddos.  After my 4th child was 2 years old, I answered the ad for the church and was hired!!
The BEST part of my job is THE PEOPLE!  I have the privilege to witness God at work through them...experiencing their true servant hearts.  So many never seek anything in return.  I use them as my role models in life.
My husband Kurt, and I, live on a small acreage by the airport with our mini donkeys and cows.  We enjoy spending time with our mommas, friends, and our 6 children and their families, including 6 beautiful grandgifts!
staff.name: Connie Heeren
staff.duties: I do everything including the bulletin. (except IT)    :-)

staff.bio: I have been volunteering with the church for many years and was blessed to become part of the staff in 2025.  I was born and raised in the Rapid City area all my life and my family have been members of this parish since I was a baby.  My husband, Tom Parson, and I live in Rapid with our three boxers and enjoy spending time with family and friends.
staff.name: Melanie Karp
staff.duties: I work with Connie in the office by answering phones, maintaining member records, taking care of most of the bulletin boards, helping organize many of the adult events in the church and presenting book studies to encourage continued faith formation in adults.

staff.bio: Anthony Flores is a dedicated member of the St. Thérèse the Little Flower parish community, serving as the OCIA Coordinator. With a deep commitment to faith formation, Anthony guides individuals through the process of becoming fully initiated members of the Catholic Church.
staff.name: Anthony Flores
staff.duties: Anthony serves as the OCIA Coordinator, guiding individuals through the process of becoming fully initiated members of the Catholic Church. He is passionate about helping others grow in their faith and understanding of Catholic teachings.
